dct_description_sm: The dataset records surface water quality results gathered by community members and environmental consultants on behalf of the community of Conklin, Alberta for their ongoing Indigenous Community Based Monitoring Program funded by the Oil Sand Monitoring Program. The program began in 2018 and has steadily grown in scope and sample size throughout the years. This ongoing monitoring program is intended to capture long term water quality trends within Christina Lake and to help inform the community of Conklin on the current and historic state of their lake. The sampling locations within the dataset consists of 5 lakes, 12 riparian shallow groundwater wells, and 12 streams. Data collection is carried out during the growing months, with field visits typically being within the spring, summer, and fall months, laboratory sampling typically happens in the summer months of July or August.
